issues.actual: Receipt validator requires TERMINATED, nonempty real-version monitors, two backend names and total<=assessment count; does not require complete unique plan jobs, K01/K02 success/expected poses and committed placements or recovery obligations. ERROR reservations/results and partial record sets are not excluded by this completion predicate. Completion review is an unversioned three-field subset check, not closed schema or binding to exact completion records/count ledger.

Explicitly require frozen required job/case/outcome/recovery coverage, reject duplicates/omissions/technical failure as completion; preserve negative adapter-only and public negative NOT_RUN boundaries. Add locally fabricated receipt validation fixtures with all business dispatch forbidden.
